title: SRIT India IPO Details
intro:
SRIT India IPO is a book build issue of ₹218.40 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 1.68 crore shares of ₹218.40 crore.

SRIT India IPO opens for subscription on Sep 28, 2026 and closes on Sep 30, 2026. The allotment for the SRIT India IPO is expected to be finalized on Oct 1, 2026. SRIT India IPO will list on NSE and BSE with a tentative listing date fixed as Oct 6, 2026.

SRIT India IPO is set issue price band at ₹123 to ₹130 per share. The lot size for an application is 115 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹14,950 (115 shares) (based on upper price).

Choice Capital Advisors Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Kfin Technologies Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to SRIT India IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in September 1999, SRIT India Limited is a Bengaluru-headquartered Information Technology and Information Technology enabled Services (IT/ITeS) solutions company providing digital solutions, custom application development and system integration services. With 26 years of industry experience, the Company designs, implements and operates digital platforms for Government entities and Enterprises in India and select overseas markets.The Company operates across three verticals: healthcare, electronic governance, and telecommunications and broadband. Its offerings include healthcare information systems, digital health platforms, e-governance solutions, cybersecurity, enterprise software, networking, connectivity, fibre optic infrastructure, system integration, automation and managed services. The Company also provides configurable and customised solutions that can be integrated with third-party platforms and has commenced developing AI-enabled solutions across its key verticals.

In the last decade, the Company has executed more than 103 projects with an aggregate order value of approximately ₹12,347.16 million for Government and Enterprise customers. Its projects include healthcare platforms, nationwide banking connectivity, state-wide fibre networks, AI-driven traffic management and power transformer monitoring solutions. The Company has a presence across multiple Indian states and also operates internationally through its Qatar operations.

The Company's delivery processes are appraised at CMMI Level 5 and SSE-CMM and are certified to ISO 27034-1:2011, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and ISO 45001:2018. Revenue from operations increased from ₹3,893.47 million in Fiscal 2025 to ₹4,499.99 million in Fiscal 2026, while profit after tax increased from ₹336.04 million to ₹432.89 million during the same period.

As of June 30, 2026, the Company had 177 permanent employees, 7 contract-specific employees and 107 consultants. Its experienced workforce supports application development, project management, operations, solution architecture, support engineering, quality management and service delivery.
strengths: Diversified presence across three key verticals.
Experienced Promoters and Senior Management team.
End-to-end digital solutions and integration capabilities.
26 years of industry experience and established track record.
Strong Government and Enterprise project execution track record.

faqs.question: How to apply in SRIT India IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in SRIT India IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in SRIT India IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in SRIT India IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' SRIT India IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: When SRIT India IPO will open?
faqs.answer: The SRIT India IPO opens on Mon, Sep 28, 2026 and closes on Wed, Sep 30, 2026.

faqs.question: What is the lot size of SRIT India IPO?
faqs.answer: SRIT India IPO lot size is 115 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹14,950 .

faqs.question: How to apply for SRIT India IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in SRIT India IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is SRIT India IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for SRIT India IPO will be done on Thursday, October 1, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Mon, Oct 5, 2026 . Check the SRIT India IPO allotment status .

faqs.question: When is SRIT India IPO listing date ?
faqs.answer: The SRIT India IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Tue, Oct 6, 2026 .
